# Scoring audit: overlap improved; ARC parity not established

The bounded candidate fixes real synchronization/lifetime defects and removes the capture-side stream fence in the observed model window. The two observer-off product comparisons do **not** satisfy the predeclared ARC-parity screen: candidate throughput was +0.532% and −2.220% versus the corresponding ARC controls; second-run median release TTFT was +11.995%. Do not promote this as a throughput win or claim Astra acceptance. Root-owned independent Astra final review remains pending.

All 360 requests across eight completed lifecycles matched exact prompts, all 26,112 output tokens and ordered native keys; 48,552 independently recomputed block-key recurrences passed. All transfer jobs succeeded, with no observed prefetch allocation failures. Measured candidate: 338 native CPU tests passed with CUDA initialization forbidden. Separate postmatrix stdout-only followup: 339 passed; **not GPU-measured**.

## Frozen design and provenance

Serial order: diagnostics old/new, then ARC→old→new→new→old→ARC. Products use old V3 opportunity/synchronous stride8/flat versus candidate opportunity/asynchronous stride8/flat; ARC legitimately disables semantic capture/shared scorer/prefetch. All source and runtime profilers OFF in products; common compact terminal/key/block-table/capture counters remain. Candidate async operational telemetry is additional product overhead and was not removed from timings. No future labels, synthetic scores, oracle return hints, threshold changes, qualification warmup, model/environment install/build/download, or production-baseline edits.

Same cached **Qwen3-4B dense**, BF16/TP1/eager, maxseq3, block16, 640 GPU blocks (1440 MiB), 448 MiB DRAM (199 blocks), staging cap192 inside the fixed640 pool, threshold2, ARC retention, known-prefix hints, native-adoption flag unchanged; PYTHONHASHSEED4109. Same 6-agent closed-loop/12-background simulated trace:45requests/3264outputtokens per arm. Agent returns depend on their actual previous completion plus private tool wait; fixed background releases. Policy sees only completed prefix/session and fixed250ms estimate, never future actual wait or abandonment. Fixed external replay was rejected because predecessor outputs and causal release dependencies would need care; all arms retain the same original closed-loop process.

Source/input/model metadata pins: `evidence/{prepared,baseline-pins,candidate-pins,frozen,environment-entry,protected-pins-final}.json`. Weight provenance uses cached LFS metadata and sizes; 8GB weights were not rehashed. Runtime is the previously reconstructed source subset plus compatible precompiled wheel, not a claim of the unavailable historical commit. `evidence/runtime-identity.json`, prior reconstruction receipts, and retained adoption runtime patch pin that identity. No runtime production change in this task.

Two startup-only failures served no requests and are preserved: task-local trace accessed KV group before initialization; driver initially used invalid ARC/opportunity configuration. Corrected startup guard and ARC config, not production semantics. Diagnostics precede final CPU-only retired-ID/nonfinite safety corrections; exact deltas/freezes retained. No product outcome was inspected before the candidate freeze.

## Observer-off products

TTFT means intended release→first token, including queueing and release lateness. All arms completed45/45,3264tokens;31/45 exceeded the descriptive1s reference. ITL uses3219 observed token intervals. Throughput denominator is complete client load start→last completion, including causal waits/queueing, not GPU busy time.

| Arm | tokens/s | elapsed s | mean / median TTFT ms | background mean TTFT ms | mean ITL ms | executed prompt tokens | capture callbacks |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| arc1 | 82.298 | 39.661 | 4401.2 / 2747.3 | 7381.6 | 32.856 | 80499 | 0 |
| old1 | 81.849 | 39.878 | 4398.8 / 2839.7 | 7376.9 | 32.859 | 80563 | 144 |
| new1 | 82.736 | 39.451 | 4374.2 / 2729.6 | 7325.5 | 32.596 | 80531 | 143 |
| new2 | 80.343 | 40.626 | 4378.0 / 3084.5 | 7268.0 | 32.803 | 77747 | 148 |
| old2 | 82.474 | 39.576 | 4403.5 / 2837.5 | 7391.9 | 32.809 | 80531 | 143 |
| arc2 | 82.167 | 39.724 | 4418.1 / 2754.2 | 7416.1 | 32.935 | 80499 | 0 |

| Pair | throughput delta | mean TTFT delta | median TTFT delta | background mean TTFT delta |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| arc1 → new1 | +0.532% | -0.612% | -0.644% | -0.760% |
| old1 → new1 | +1.084% | -0.559% | -3.877% | -0.696% |
| arc2 → new2 | -2.220% | -0.907% | +11.995% | -1.998% |
| old2 → new2 | -2.584% | -0.578% | +8.708% | -1.676% |

Before results the engineering target was throughput within1% of ARC with mean/median/background TTFT no more than5% worse. First candidate/ARC pair passes, second fails. Two samples are descriptive, not statistical equivalence; no significance/p95 claim. Old-semantic throughput spans81.849–82.474, ARC82.167–82.298, candidate80.343–82.736tokens/s. Mean TTFT/background/ITL improved in both candidate/ARC pairs, while the second median and last completion worsened. This mixed result cannot be summarized as a consistent speedup.

The second candidate run executed77747 prompt tokens versus80499 for ARC2, had19376 versus16576 GPU-hit tokens, and ended with agent4-turn5 instead of agent3-turn5. Its last release was38.469s and completion40.626s versus ARC2's37.578/39.724s. Client-active time-weighted mean was7.448 versus7.673. These are observed closed-loop/cache trajectory differences, **not proof of the cause** of the regression. Every per-request release/submit TTFT, release lateness, prompt-work and timing delta is retained in `measurements.csv`, `paired-requests.csv`, `evidence/comparisons.json`. API CPU counters include startup and cannot provide worker timed-only CPU cost.

## Actual-model timeline: improved overlap, bounded attribution

Kineto/CUPTI produced real kernel/copy events with correlation IDs; nsys unavailable, nothing installed. Each diagnostic records12 post-startup steps after first durable summary. Both windows contain three1-token decode requests/step and one durable summary. No startup/warmup aggregate is labeled load-only. Candidate diagnostic uses continuous async stride1 deliberately to exercise scoring; this is **not** the product mode or performance comparison.

Old/new host windows387.221/378.208ms; recorded GPU-activity union339.180/340.134ms (87.594%/89.936%). No-recorded-GPU-activity48.040/38.074ms; cross-stream activity overlap0.006/0.373ms. These observer-on windows are short, not an estimate of whole-run speedup. GPU intervals are clipped to the host model-step window; tail activity outside it is excluded. Largest internal activity gap0.983/0.512ms. Main-stream busy time339.175/340.128ms; candidate scoring stream0.376ms, largely overlapping the main stream.

Capture.extract12calls:22.173→3.963ms inclusive host wall. All12 old captures contain stream-sync calls totaling17.005ms; candidate captures contain none. Correlation analysis shows old waits enclosed by aten::copy_/_to_copy/to, while previously launched model kernels (attention/matmul/norm/rotary/cache kernels) run. Example first old capture1.948ms contains1.507ms wait with31 prior-launched GPU activities; next attention host dispatch follows capture by0.004ms. Candidate first capture0.342ms, no stream-sync; next attention follows by0.010ms. This is evidence of a blocked host launch boundary and its removal. It does not turn the prior14s host aggregate into14s GPU arithmetic or14s recoverable latency. Source-side cat alone previously moved waits; owned deferred scoring is measured here as a combined pipeline.

Recorded inclusive host wall milliseconds (calls), **not additive**, not threadCPU:

| Component | old continuous sync | candidate continuous async |
|---|---:|---:|
| capture.prepare_layout | 9.594 (24) | 8.707 (24) |
| capture.extract | 22.173 (12) | 3.963 (12) |
| scoring.callback | 2.831 (12) | 2.020 (12) |
| scoring.readback | 0.897 (24) | not recorded |
| scoring.rank_metadata | 0.200 (12) | not recorded |
| metadata.build_worker | 0.365 (11) | 0.616 (11) |
| metadata.pop_scores | 0.040 (11) | 0.329 (11) |
| scheduler.consume_worker | 0.598 (22) | 2.642 (22) |
| scheduler.build_metadata | 1.432 (11) | 1.447 (11) |
| scheduler.prefetch_decision | 0.336 (11) | 0.337 (11) |
| scoring.ema_apply | 0.053 (11) | 0.047 (11) |
| logging.json_encode | 0.091 (2) | 0.740 (68) |

Old vector-math host enqueue scope1.875ms/24calls, blocking score readback0.897ms/24calls. Candidate score executor host spans are absent from this Kineto export even though CUDA side-stream activity is present: do not invent its readback/queue/threadCPU breakdown. Old group_query ranges are nested/duplicated; compare outer capture.extract, not group totals. Candidate query-select0.363ms/24ranges and head-reduce1.012ms/24ranges are inclusive observer scopes. Worker metadata/consumer and JSON costs increase with async publication; they are not “free overlap.” `timeline-components.csv`, `evidence/{timeline-analysis,trace-correlations}.json` and compressed raw traces retain all scopes, critical excerpts and correlations.

No summary build/store occurs in this12step steady-decode window; no causal claim about summary/D2H critical path. Major unresolved attribution: async executor threadCPU/readback/queue phases, timed-only worker CPU, isolated private-stream DMA, per-request kernel-ready times, complete HTTP/RPC/network cost, and Kineto observer perturbation. Previous score_components diagnostic component profiles remain separate historical evidence; they are not substituted as matching measurements of this candidate. No residual arithmetic fills missing components.

## Semantic work, transfers and memory

All four semantic products made4–5 nonempty nominations but **zero budget-constrained ranking decisions** and zero scored competitive opportunities. Real capture ran143–148 callbacks. Candidate opportunity async submitted zero jobs; all-fit bypasses remain explicitly unscored, not fake-zero scores. Thus product results measure real opportunity capture/prefetch bookkeeping but do not establish ranking utility or organic async-decision performance. Real ARC-manager/two-competing-source CPU integration exercises that decision mechanism separately; tiny CUDA fixture verifies actual score equivalence/events/ownership, not organic throughput.

Continuous async diagnostic:1042callbacks,1029jobs submitted/ready/published,13drop-newest rejections; original feature timestamps retained. It finished with zero pending items/bytes. Different observation coverage from synchronous1179callbacks is disclosed, not silently equated. Queue cap2,64MiB actual retained backing/workspace accounting, one stream owner. No stale/nonfinite observations refresh EMA.

Every product D2H total24.75MiB/11storedblocks. ARC demand H2D38.25MiB; old1/new1/new2/old2 demand H2D27/22.5/18/22.5MiB. Completed speculative H2D13.5/18/15.75/18MiB, consuming5/7/6/7blocks; unused speculative bytes and on-time coverage are in `evidence/validity.json`. GPU-resident-hit and demand-restoration bookkeeping are distinct. All actual consumed prefixes used the real transfer+splice fallback; **native direct-adoption count0** for this growing-conversation trace despite enabled flag. Do not claim zero splice, zero H2D, or capacity gain.

Sampled staging occupancy peaked2blocks (zero ARC); sampled pool consistency passed. Pool snapshots are phase samples, not a continuous occupancy integral. Whole-run allocator peak approximately9426MiB except new2~9566MiB; includes startup/prefill and differing batching, so is neither poststartup peak nor reduced preallocated KV VRAM. D2H creates CPU copies and does not itself prove GPU release/reuse. No active GPU blocks reclaimed; no admission change.

## Implementation and branch decisions

Measured patch: `scoring-audit-measured.patch` (four production modules plus tests). Baseline source unchanged.

- **Fixed:** empty and nonempty ordinary get_finished retirement no longer drain unrelated futures. Final-source query lease survives within original boundedTTL; ready-only metadata publishes later, reset/shutdown deliberately drain. Gated real wrapper tests prove no unrelated fence and eventual final observation.
- **Fixed:** actual unique summary backing retained/accounted; only method-required immutable fields survive in job payloads, bounded workspaces charged; full queue rejects before scanning bank. One owner for one scoring stream; partial GPU exception fences owned reads before releasing inputs.
- **Implemented:** owned slice/cat row selection and reentry-safe layout consumption; exact GQA/zero/padded/strided/ownership tests. Existing bounded controller extended to flat mean/meanTP1 opportunity mode. Query/event/summary publication versions, request generation, DRAM residency token and hint lease travel to final consumer; cancellation/expiry/reset/same-key reinsertion fail closed. Same-ID reuse invalidates old results. Nonfinite request rejected entirely, not replaced with zero.
- **Reduced:** cached attention-op identity, instrumentation-only dispatch bypass, guarded debug formatting, continuous-empty-bank extraction skip after stride advance. Opportunity capture stays active for an empty bank to retain the final query needed later; semantics not weakened for parity.
- **Investigated, retained:** summary/D2H source-block fencing. Removing broad fences without native event replacement could free live inputs;11stores and no store inside captured window give no evidence this dominates. Existing overlap/failure tests pass; native overlap knob not enabled blindly.
- **Deferred with reason:** mutable incremental stack reuse across executor, competing-request batching and CPU score mirror. Tiny11row pool plus no organic competitive score jobs give little payoff evidence, while publication/ownership/rank risks are real. Candidate projects immutable fields but restacks per actual job. No hidden metric/rank-policy change.
- **Deferred:** IVF/GPU ranking/kernel fusion. Eleven rows and measured tiny scoring-stream cost do not justify changing exact semantics; admission policy remains root's design-only investigation.
- **Postmatrix CPU-only fix:** async products emitted1141/1178 status records (~396/409KB), all identical idle snapshots, despite no score jobs; continuous diagnostic emitted6337asyncrecords/~5.17MB. `postmatrix-status-only.patch` suppresses identical status stdout at consumer, retains all native metadata and operational events, logs each transition.339tests pass; separate `candidate-status/` pins. No product run uses this patch and no latency saving is claimed. This is a remaining measurement gap, not a retroactive correction of negative results.

## Verification, limits and handback

338CPUchecks include actual ARC manager prepare/store/complete/evict/reinsert, native metadata, real tensor scores, constrained two-session nomination, gated async completion, cancellation/TTL/generation/queue/memory/lifetime cases, capture14newcases and seven prior native-admission funnel fixtures. Tiny CUDA used bounded BF16owned rows/GQA/strides and asynchronous scoring with source mutation/events;598016B peak allocation in that process;5kernels/14copies in trace. It does not certify all CUDA graph modes; all model runs eager and unsupported layouts remain guarded.

Eight completed model lifecycles total462.1s wall (includes startup/shutdown, **not measured GPU-busy seconds**); timed loads322.2s. Two additional startup-only failures were bounded and preserved. No further GPU work after matrix. Shared other owners/settings/pauses preserved, no model load outside custody, no cache/model cleanup. The native reservation, sealed restoration, owned descendant exits, lock check and final release are in separate cleanup receipts. Original source/runtime and measured baseline/candidate pins verified unchanged.

Ready for root's independent Astra review against patches, tests and raw evidence; **no independent final approval yet**, and no assertion that every possible optimization is exhausted. Consequential branches have source/tests/timeline evidence or explicit deferral reasons. ARC parity, ranking value under organic competition and capacity benefit remain unproven. Final integration should keep this distinction between measured candidate and CPU-only status followup.

Operational disclosure: heartbeat lapsed twice during CPU/report preparation (not model serving). Each uncertain reservation was handled only with previously sealed restoration and explicit reconciliation; no uncertain grant was resumed. All serving activities returned successful owned-tree-empty receipts. After the final matrix, a fresh finite CPU-only light session handled packaging/storage, with no CUDA work. See final-reconcile.json and separate package release receipts.
